user.title: National Grid US account
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use at myaccount.nationalgrid.com.

select_accounts.title: Billing accounts
select_accounts.description: Choose the billing accounts Home Assistant should track. Usage for every meter on these accounts is imported into long-term statistics.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate National Grid US
reauth_confirm.description: National Grid rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password to keep the integration running.

error.invalid_auth: National Grid rejected the email or password.
error.auth_flow_failed: National Grid's sign-in finished without returning a token. This usually means the account requires multi-factor authentication, which an integration cannot complete. Download diagnostics or run scripts/debug_nationalgrid.py for details.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach National Grid. Check your connection and try again.
error.no_accounts: This login has no linked billing accounts.

abort.already_configured: This National Grid account is already configured.

init.title: Billing accounts
init.description: Choose the billing accounts Home Assistant should track.

auth_failed.title: National Grid US sign-in failed
auth_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not sign in to National Grid for {account}.

If the same email and password work at myaccount.nationalgrid.com, the account most likely requires multi-factor authentication, which this integration cannot complete.

Select **Re-authenticate** to enter the password again. To see exactly where the sign-in stopped, open Settings → Devices & services → National Grid US → ⋮ → Download diagnostics, or run scripts/debug_nationalgrid.py, and attach the result to an issue.

init.title: Re-authenticate National Grid US
init.description: Enter the current password for {username}. If National Grid requires multi-factor authentication for this account, the sign-in will fail again and the diagnostics download will show where it stopped.

error.invalid_auth: National Grid rejected the email or password.
error.auth_flow_failed: National Grid's sign-in finished without returning a token. This usually means the account requires multi-factor authentication, which an integration cannot complete.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach National Grid. Check your connection and try again.
